'''Rob Ronnlund Adapt And Destroy''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rob Ronnlund]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls114.htm Adapt And Destroy], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040819083207/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls114.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rob Ronnlund]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Dagobah Regionals]]
